gate_metrics_machine does not recompute the CI bounds or the test outputs (14 items in its unchecked.json). recompute_estimate and recompute_test in gate_claims_machine cover them, and I reproduced every one independently.

The effect 0.4869 shown for the AOV test is Cohen's d on the pooled standard deviation. The average-of-variances convention gives 0.4950. The analysis plan names neither, and the report labels the figure only as cohens d.

The completion rate counts the 7,491 pending orders (16.8% of the population: 3,457 direct, 4,034 partner) as not completed. summary: Every published figure is correct: I recalculated all 20 registry values from quarantine/orders.csv with my own code and they match, the clean table agrees with my derivation on every row (44531 orders), and the release gate binds all 60 numbers on the three surfaces. The release still fails on meaning. report.md labels the whole page as delivered orders only, yet seven of its eight claims count cancelled and pending orders too (44,531 orders shown, of which 29,873 were delivered, and both completion-rate denominators). The claim register gives CLM-COMPLETION-DIRECT a delivered-only population
